ground_truth_method: Manual schema-semantics preregistration from public FDIC field definitions and the frozen synthetic bank_account benchmark contract. No scorer output, model prediction, calibration result, or source row value was read to assign labels.

mappings.label_rationale: FDIC certificate identifies the institution, not the branch-level key used by the synthetic target contract.
FDIC UNINUM is the unique office/location identifier and is the closest semantic match for the branch key.
FDIC institution display name is an organization-name field suitable for the bank branch display-name target.
FDIC office name is a branch display-name field and maps to the bank branch name target.
The target contract has country code only; city is intentionally absent.
U.S. state name is not a country code and no state/province target exists.
U.S. state abbreviation is not a country code and no state/province target exists.
Postal code is intentionally absent from the target contract.
County is intentionally absent from the target contract.
Service type code describes office service category, not any account or branch target field.
Service type description is a categorical label with no target field.
FDIC data run date is extract metadata, not account validity or branch master data.
Domestic office indicator/count semantics do not match any branch or account target.
Main-office flag is not the account primary payment flag in the target contract.

explicit_exclusions.reason: CERT is institution-level while UNINUM is the frozen branch/location identifier.
MAINOFF marks institution office role, not preferred account usage.
STALP is a U.S. state abbreviation and must not be treated as a country code.
